description: Back-facing chibi wizard redrawn for coarse mobile-readable pixel structure. Lavender tousled hair, off-white tunic, navy scarf, brown belt and pouch, navy trousers, brown boots, and a small turquoise accent. Neutral standing pose with arms relaxed at the sides; no staff.
usage: Primary player-character back-view battle/exploration sprite for a vertical mobile RPG.
style_summary: Chunky high-quality pixel art derived from the supplied wizard identity, with a 59-cell-tall silhouette, colored outlines, soft multi-step internal shading, and small-scale mobile readability.

visual_identity.primary_read: large fluffy lavender hair mass over a compact adventurer body
visual_identity.hair: pale lavender, layered and spiky, large central rear fringe mass with curled top tuft
visual_identity.clothing: off-white tunic with navy scarf and navy trousers
visual_identity.leather: medium/dark brown belt, wrist guards, side pouch, boots
visual_identity.accent: small turquoise detail reserved for the wizard

silhouette_profile: Top-heavy rounded hair silhouette; narrow neck/scarf; compact torso; straight relaxed arms; short separated legs and boots.

proportion_profile.symmetry: mostly symmetrical with slight pouch asymmetry

pixel_structure.method_note: Final output is rebuilt onto a logical 59-cell height and enlarged by nearest-neighbor blocks; no palette quantization was applied.

pixel_density: coarse character pixels for mobile readability; each logical cell is approximately 7x7 physical pixels on the 512 canvas

palette_profile.temperature_balance: cool character identity with warm leather support tones
palette_profile.restriction: do not move turquoise identity accent to enemy designs

shading_profile: Several tonal steps per material with soft local transitions preserved inside coarse blocks; no forced 24/32-color quantization.

lighting_profile.highlight_behavior: strongest on upper-left hair lobes and upper garment planes

outline_profile: Colored dark outlines based on the local material hue rather than pure black.

texture/material_profile.hair: soft matte fluffy strands simplified into broad clustered locks
texture/material_profile.leather: warm dark leather with compact highlights

detail_density: medium within the head and scarf, low-to-medium on torso and legs; small details are kept to one or two logical cells.
readability_rules: Hair mass must remain the dominant silhouette cue.
Scarf must remain clearly navy and separate from the pale tunic.
Pouch must remain readable on one hip.
No hand-held staff in this asset.
Avoid sub-cell micro-detail that disappears at mobile scale.
mood/world_context: friendly young fantasy wizard suitable for the opening region of a mobile RPG
consistency_must_keep: lavender fluffy hair and curled top tuft
allowed_variations: subtle hue shifts within lavender/navy/brown families
animation poses that preserve silhouette and proportions
prohibited_variations: front-facing pose for this back-view asset
palette quantization to a fixed small color count
adding a staff or weapon into the hand
changing to realistic, 3D-rendered or painterly non-pixel style
variant_generation_notes: For future poses, construct directly on the same 59-cell logical height rather than shrinking a high-resolution sprite. Keep the head/hair proportion and material color families stable.
relation_to_other_assets: Visual scale anchor for enemy_goblin_scout; lighting and outline behavior are shared with bg_forest.
reference_basis: User-supplied wizard back-view image for character identity and style direction, plus ART_REQUEST_PHASE1_5.md for production constraints.
originality_note: Redrawn as an original project asset using the supplied project character as the only character reference; no external commercial-game design was copied.
license_risk_check: Low based on provided materials; no external logo, trademark, or identifiable third-party character design intentionally reproduced.
